prompt1_result.name: Concomitant development of neurologic and cardiac immune-related adverse effects in patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors for melanoma
prompt1_result.ICI_dosage: Ipilimumab: 1 mg/kg every 6 weeks; Nivolumab: 240 mg every 2 weeks
prompt1_result.irAE_Symptoms: Rapidly worsening fatigue affecting upper then lower extremities, bilateral ptosis, right abducens nerve paresis, diffuse asymmetric muscle weakness (right>left), loss of proprioception and vibration at lower limbs distally, absent reflexes, later dysphagia and weakness of neck flexors
prompt1_result.jisu_regime: Along with IVIG (0.4 mg/kg/day for 5 days) in four-week cycles
prompt1_result.Symptoms_after_jisu_treatment: Gradual improvement noted, almost fully recovered by last follow-up visit 4 months after admission
prompt1_result.Symptoms_after_yzj_treatment: Gradual improvement noted, almost fully recovered by last follow-up visit 4 months after admission
prompt1_result.irAE_outcome: Complete resolution after 13 weeks, no disease progression (melanoma)
